provenance.model_status: experimental; physiological parameters and readout are assumed

assumptions: Induced subgraph of all cells annotated exactly LC4, LPLC2 or DNp01; other cells and their inputs are excluded.
Positive sign assigned by explicit cell-type policy for this experimentally excitatory pathway; not inferred universally from transmitter labels.
Incoming synapse counts are linearly normalized to a total absolute gain of 14 per postsynaptic neuron; this is an illustrative gain, not a physiological fit.
External stimulation targets annotated visual projection populations; no retina, pixel processor, angular-size or angular-velocity encoder is modeled.
Jump is the filtered mean activity of two GF descending neurons; muscles, electrical synapses and body physics are not modeled.
Preserve source tracing status and transmitter-confidence annotations; inclusion does not imply complete proofreading.
